about.title: Everyday Technology. A Simpler Way to Shop.
about.intro: At lumeero, we believe shopping for electronics should be straightforward, convenient, and enjoyable.
about.body: Operated by Stone Canyon Leathers, lumeero is a US-based online electronics store focused on helping customers discover products, compare their options, and shop with greater confidence.

values.title: Clarity
values.text: We aim to present product information, pricing, and purchasing details in a way customers can easily understand.

values.title: Convenience
values.text: From browsing and comparing products to completing checkout, we want the shopping process to feel simple and organized.

values.title: Customer support
values.text: We believe customers should have a clear way to ask questions, request assistance, and find information about their orders.

sections.title: Discover technology that fits your life
paragraphs: Technology plays an important role in how we work, connect, create, learn, and enjoy entertainment.

Whether you're upgrading your computer, improving your gaming setup, exploring new electronics, or replacing an essential accessory, our online catalog is designed to help you find products that suit your needs.
bullets: Computers & Components: Explore computing hardware, memory, and essential upgrades.
Graphics Cards: Discover graphics solutions for gaming, productivity, and creative applications.
Gaming Consoles & Accessories: Browse gaming hardware and related accessories.
Computer Monitors: Find displays for work, entertainment, and everyday computing.
3D Printers: Explore technology for creative projects, prototyping, and personal fabrication.
I/O Cards & Adapters: Find connectivity solutions and computer expansion accessories.
Audio & Electronics: Discover products designed for entertainment and everyday use.
Power Adapters & Chargers: Explore accessories that help keep compatible devices connected and powered.

sections.title: Our mission
paragraphs: Our mission is to provide a convenient online shopping destination where customers can explore electronics with the information they need to make informed purchasing decisions.

about.ctaTitle: Let's find the right technology for you
about.ctaBody: Whether you're exploring computer upgrades, gaming equipment, electronics accessories, or new technology for everyday use, lumeero is here to help make your shopping journey simpler.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
faq.intro: Find answers to common questions about shopping, products, payments, shipping, order tracking, returns, refunds, and customer support.

items.question: What is lumeero?
items.answer: lumeero is a US-based online electronics store offering a selection of technology products, computer components, gaming equipment, and electronic accessories. Our goal is to make shopping for electronics more convenient by providing organized product categories, useful product information, and accessible customer support.

items.question: What is the legal business name behind lumeero?
items.answer: lumeero operates under the legal business name Stone Canyon Leathers. Our published business contact address is: 6715 4th St NW Los Ranchos De Albuquerque, NM 87107 United States

items.question: Where is lumeero located?
items.answer: Our business contact address is located in Los Ranchos De Albuquerque, New Mexico, United States. Our store operates online through https://lumeero.us. Our published business address is not automatically a retail pickup or product return location.

items.question: Is lumeero an online store?
items.answer: Yes. lumeero operates as an online electronics shopping destination. Customers can browse available products, review specifications, and place orders through our website.

items.question: What types of products does lumeero sell?
items.answer: Our electronics catalog may include: Computers and computer components Graphics cards Gaming consoles and accessories Computer monitors 3D printers Computer memory and storage accessories I/O cards and adapters Audio equipment Chargers and power adapters Other electronic devices and accessories Product categories and availability may change.

items.question: How can I contact lumeero?
items.answer: You can contact us through: Email: info@lumeero.site Phone: +1 (505) 345-4232 Live Chat: Available 24/7 Our regular telephone business hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time. Contact Us

items.question: What are your customer service hours?
items.answer: Our live chat channel is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Our regular telephone business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT). Email inquiries can be submitted at any time.

items.question: Can I visit your business address to purchase products?
items.answer: lumeero operates as an online store. We do not advertise walk-in shopping or in-person pickup through our published business address. Please contact customer support before making any plans involving our business location.

items.question: Are the products listed on your website available for purchase?
items.answer: Products shown as available can generally be added to your cart and submitted for purchase. However, inventory information can occasionally change or require verification. If an ordered product becomes unavailable, we will review the situation and communicate the available options, including a refund where applicable.

items.question: Are your electronics brand new?
items.answer: Product condition should be identified on the individual product listing. Where a product is described as New, it is represented as new according to the listing details. If a product is refurbished, open-box, or otherwise not new, its condition should be disclosed before purchase. Please review the individual product description or contact our support team if you need clarification.

items.question: Are your products genuine?
items.answer: We aim to describe products accurately, including their brand, model, specifications, and condition. Customers should review the relevant product listing for identifying details. If you have questions about a particular manufacturer's product, contact our team before ordering.

items.question: Why are some of your products priced lower than other retailers?
items.answer: Retail prices can vary for several reasons, including purchasing costs, inventory availability, promotional pricing, product configurations, and market conditions. We aim to offer competitive prices while providing clear product information. A lower price does not necessarily indicate a difference in product condition. Always review the individual listing for the exact product model, condition, and included accessories.

items.question: Do you offer discounts or promotional codes?
items.answer: Promotional discounts may be offered from time to time. When a promotion is available, its terms, eligibility requirements, and expiration date will be provided through the relevant offer. If you have a valid promotional code, enter it during checkout where supported.

items.question: Can I request a discount on a product?
items.answer: You can contact customer support to ask about currently available promotions. Discounts are not guaranteed and depend on active offers and product eligibility.

items.question: Can I purchase multiple units of the same product?
items.answer: You can order available quantities shown on the product page, subject to inventory and any applicable purchase limits. For larger orders, contact our support team to discuss product availability and order requirements.

items.question: Do product prices include sales tax?
items.answer: Applicable sales taxes, if any, are calculated according to the relevant transaction and displayed during checkout. Review your final order total before confirming payment.

items.question: Are product specifications always accurate?
items.answer: We aim to provide accurate and useful product information. However, specifications, images, and manufacturer information can occasionally contain errors or change. For compatibility-sensitive purchases, we recommend confirming the exact model number and technical requirements before ordering.

items.question: Can you help me choose the right electronic product?
items.answer: Our customer support team can assist with available product information and specifications. For compatibility questions, provide the relevant model numbers, intended use, and technical requirements. We encourage customers to verify compatibility before purchasing.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Ordering from lumeero is straightforward: 1. Browse our electronics collection. 2. Select the product you want. 3. Review the product specifications and price. 4. Add the item to your cart. 5. Proceed to checkout. 6. Enter your billing and shipping information. 7. Review the available payment options and final order total. 8. Submit your order. Once an order is accepted, you should receive confirmation through the contact information provided during checkout.

items.question: Do I need an account to place an order?
items.answer: Account requirements depend on the checkout options available on our website. If guest checkout is offered, you can place an order without creating a customer account.

items.question: How do I know my order was successfully placed?
items.answer: After successfully submitting an order, you should receive an order confirmation or see a confirmation page. If you do not receive confirmation, check your spam or junk email folder and contact customer support before attempting another payment.

items.question: Can I modify my order after placing it?
items.answer: Contact us as soon as possible if you need to request a change. Depending on the order's fulfillment status, certain modifications may be possible. Changes cannot be guaranteed once processing or shipment has begun.

items.question: Can I change my shipping address?
items.answer: If your order has not been shipped, contact customer support immediately with your order number and the requested correction. We will review whether the address can still be updated. Once a package has entered the carrier's delivery network, changes may be restricted or unavailable.

items.question: Can I cancel an order?
items.answer: You can request cancellation by contacting customer support. Cancellation eligibility depends on the order's fulfillment status and our published Cancellation Policy. Read Our Order Cancellation Policy

items.question: What should I do if I placed an order by mistake?
items.answer: Contact us promptly through live chat or email and provide your order number. Our team can review the order's current status and explain the available options.

items.question: What payment methods does lumeero accept?
items.answer: Available payment methods are displayed during checkout. Depending on the active payment integrations, options may include eligible credit or debit cards, digital payment services, or installment payment providers. Please refer to checkout for the payment methods currently supported. View Our Payment Policy

items.question: Is it safe to make payments on your website?
items.answer: We aim to provide a secure checkout experience using supported payment integrations and appropriate website security measures. Payment processing may be handled by independent payment service providers. No online system can guarantee absolute security, so customers should also take reasonable precautions to protect their accounts and payment information.

items.question: Do you offer Buy Now, Pay Later?
items.answer: Buy Now, Pay Later options may be available if an eligible financing provider is enabled at checkout. Availability depends on the payment services currently supported and the customer's eligibility. If no installment payment option is displayed, it is not currently available for that checkout. Learn About Buy Now, Pay Later

items.question: Can I pay in installments?
items.answer: Installment payment availability depends on whether an eligible provider is offered during checkout. Approval, payment schedules, interest, and fees are determined by the relevant provider.

items.question: Why was my payment declined?
items.answer: A payment may be declined for several reasons, including: Incorrect payment details Insufficient available funds Card issuer restrictions Failed authentication Payment provider eligibility requirements Temporary processing errors If your payment is declined, verify your details and contact your bank or payment provider if necessary.

items.question: My payment was charged, but I did not receive an order confirmation. What should I do?
items.answer: Please avoid repeatedly submitting payment. Contact us at info@lumeero.site with the approximate transaction time, payment method, and email address used during checkout. Do not send your complete card number, card security code, or banking credentials.

items.question: Can I use multiple payment methods for one order?
items.answer: Split-payment functionality depends on the checkout capabilities currently available. If the website does not offer this option, multiple payment methods cannot be combined for a single order through the standard checkout.

items.question: What currency are prices displayed in?
items.answer: Prices on our US storefront are displayed in United States Dollars (USD) unless otherwise stated.

items.question: Where does lumeero ship?
items.answer: Our storefront is intended for customers in the United States. Delivery eligibility is determined by the available shipping destinations and restrictions shown during checkout. For questions about a specific destination, contact our support team before ordering.

items.question: Do you offer free shipping?
items.answer: Shipping charges, including any free-shipping offers, are determined by our published Shipping Policy and the shipping options displayed during checkout. Any applicable shipping charges should be shown before you confirm your order. Review Shipping & Delivery

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Estimated processing and delivery times depend on the product, destination, shipping method, and carrier. The applicable delivery information is provided in our Shipping Policy or during checkout. Delivery estimates are not guarantees unless expressly stated otherwise.

items.question: How can I track my order?
items.answer: If tracking information is available, it will be provided through the applicable order communication or tracking service. You can also contact customer support with your order number for assistance. Track Your Order

items.question: Why is my tracking number not updating?
items.answer: Tracking updates may take time to appear after a shipment is prepared or handed to the carrier. Carrier scans may also be delayed during transit. If your tracking information has not updated as expected, contact our support team for assistance.

items.question: What happens if my delivery is delayed?
items.answer: Shipping delays can occur because of carrier disruptions, weather, holidays, or other circumstances. If your delivery is taking longer than expected, contact us with your order number so we can review the available shipment information.

items.question: What if my package is marked delivered but I haven't received it?
items.answer: First, check the delivery location, nearby entrances, and any available carrier delivery details. If you still cannot locate the package, contact our support team. We can review the available tracking information and explain the next steps.

items.question: Can I request expedited shipping?
items.answer: Expedited shipping is available only when specifically offered during checkout or confirmed by our support team. Please do not assume faster shipping is available for every product or destination.

items.question: Do you offer international shipping?
items.answer: International delivery is not advertised as a standard service on our US storefront. Customers should rely on the eligible destinations displayed during checkout or contact support for clarification.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: Our Return and Refund Policy explains which purchases may be returned, the applicable return period, product-condition requirements, and the process for requesting a return. Please review the policy before initiating a return. Read Our Return and Refund Policy

items.question: How do I request a return?
items.answer: To request a return: 1. Contact customer support. 2. Provide your order number. 3. Explain the reason for your return. 4. Provide photographs or supporting information if requested. 5. Wait for the applicable return instructions and authorization. 6. Follow the approved return procedure. Do not send products to our business contact address without receiving return instructions.

items.question: Can I return a product if I change my mind?
items.answer: Change-of-mind return eligibility depends on the product, its condition, the applicable return period, and our published Return and Refund Policy. Please review the policy or contact customer support before sending an item back.

items.question: What if I receive a damaged product?
items.answer: Contact us promptly with your order number, a description of the damage, and relevant photographs. Our team will review the report and explain the available options under the applicable policies and consumer protection laws.

items.question: What if I receive the wrong item?
items.answer: Contact customer support with your order number and photographs of the item received. We will review the discrepancy and explain the appropriate next steps.

items.question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
items.answer: Return shipping responsibilities depend on the reason for the return and the applicable policy. For example, change-of-mind returns may be handled differently from verified incorrect, damaged, or defective product claims. Please review our Return and Refund Policy for the applicable conditions.

items.question: Do you charge restocking fees?
items.answer: Any applicable restocking fees or other return-related charges must be disclosed in our published Return and Refund Policy. Contact customer support if you need clarification before requesting a return.

items.question: How long does a refund take?
items.answer: Refund processing times depend on the applicable return process, approval status, and payment provider. After a refund is initiated, your bank or payment provider may require additional time to make the funds available. Refer to our Return and Refund Policy for the applicable timeline.

items.question: Will my refund go back to my original payment method?
items.answer: Approved refunds are generally directed through the original payment method where supported. The final refund process may depend on the payment provider and transaction circumstances.

items.question: Can I exchange a product?
items.answer: Exchange availability depends on the product and applicable store policy. Contact customer support to discuss the available options.

items.question: Can I return a product directly to your business address?
items.answer: No product should be sent to our published business contact address without prior authorization. Contact our support team for the correct return instructions and designated destination.

items.question: Do your electronics come with a warranty?
items.answer: Warranty coverage varies by product and manufacturer. Where applicable, product listings or accompanying documentation may identify available warranty terms. Not every product necessarily includes the same warranty coverage. Read Warranty & Product Support

items.question: How can I check whether a product has a warranty?
items.answer: Review the product description, manufacturer documentation, and any applicable warranty information. If the information is unclear, contact customer support with the product name or model number.

items.question: What should I do if my product stops working?
items.answer: Contact customer support with your order number and a description of the issue. Depending on the product and circumstances, return eligibility, manufacturer warranty terms, or other support options may apply.

items.question: Are you an authorized retailer for every brand you sell?
items.answer: Authorization relationships vary by manufacturer and should not be assumed. Unless a specific authorization is expressly stated and verifiable, the presence of a branded product on our website does not imply an official manufacturer partnership or endorsement.

items.question: Do you provide installation or technical repair services?
items.answer: Installation and repair services should not be assumed to be included with a product purchase. Review the product listing or contact support to determine whether any additional services are specifically available.

items.question: How is my personal information used?
items.answer: Personal information may be used to process orders, provide customer support, manage transactions, and operate our website. For details about the information collected and how it is handled, review our Privacy Policy. Privacy Policy

items.question: Do you share customer information with third parties?
items.answer: Certain service providers may receive information necessary to support payment processing, order fulfillment, website operations, or other legitimate business activities. Our Privacy Policy explains the applicable data-handling practices.

items.question: Does your website use cookies?
items.answer: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support essential functionality, remember preferences, and provide other website features. Review our Cookie Policy for additional information. Cookie Policy

items.question: How can I request access to or deletion of my personal information?
items.answer: You can contact info@lumeero.site with your privacy-related request. Requests will be reviewed according to applicable law and our published privacy procedures. Your Privacy Choices

items.question: What should I do if the website is not working correctly?
items.answer: Try refreshing the page, checking your internet connection, or using an updated browser. If the problem continues, contact our support team with a description of the issue and, if possible, a screenshot.

items.question: How can I report an accessibility issue?
items.answer: If you experience difficulty using our website, please email info@lumeero.site. Include the page URL and a description of the accessibility barrier so we can review the issue. Accessibility Statement

items.question: What information should I provide when contacting support?
items.answer: For order-related questions, please provide: Your order number The name associated with the order The email address used during checkout A brief explanation of your inquiry For product-related concerns, include the relevant product name, model, or listing URL.

items.question: Can I contact support before purchasing?
items.answer: Yes. Customers are welcome to contact us before placing an order. Our team can assist with available product details, purchasing information, and general store policies.

items.question: What should I do if I haven't received a response?
items.answer: If you have already contacted us, please allow time for your inquiry to be reviewed. You can follow up through the same email thread or use our live chat for additional assistance.

items.question: How can I submit feedback about my shopping experience?
items.answer: We welcome constructive feedback. Send your comments or suggestions to info@lumeero.site, or use the contact form on our website.

items.question: Can I contact lumeero for business inquiries?
items.answer: Yes. General business inquiries can be submitted through our published email address. Email: info@lumeero.site

items.question: What should I do if my question isn't answered here?
items.answer: Contact our support team through one of the following channels: Live Chat: Available 24/7 Email: info@lumeero.site Phone: +1 (505) 345-4232 Telephone Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT) Contact Our Team Still Have Questions?
